rules.statement: A co-owner who has been deprived of their property can recover it from any one who has taken it, or get its value if the property has been converted into money.
rules.supporting_quote: This seems to me to be a case distinguishable from Job v. Potton ( L.R. 20 Eq. 84). There one co-owner took no more than his share, leaving untouched enough for the other co-owners; here the first and second defendants, acting together, prevented the plaintiff (a co-owner) from getting any share at all.
